notes.title: SmearFX v1.1.0 is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Smart Outline added: Now you can add smearing to images that have an outline with a much better quality.
[*]Added support for alpha channel: Now both the trail and the full animation can have different alpha values and an alpha decay.
[*]Alpha graph added to advanced mode.
[*]Added alpha slider to <Initial> and <Movement> sections.
[*]Added alpha decay slider to <Trail> section.
[/list]
[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed trail skips the last frame of the animation in advanced mode.
[*]Fixed first frame of the animation skips trail under certain conditions.
[/list]
